title: Live Q&A System
description: Interactive question and answer system where students ask questions and teachers respond in real-time

teacher.overview: Manage student questions during live sessions. Students can ask questions, upvote others' questions, and you can answer them in real-time or after session.

access: During active session, open Q&A panel
See all questions from students in chronological order
answer: Click on a question to answer it
Type your response in the answer box
Answer appears below the question for all students
manage: Sort questions by time or upvotes
Mark questions as answered without replying (if answered verbally)
Export Q&A session as PDF for reference

tips: Answer high-upvoted questions first - they interest multiple students
Encourage students to upvote instead of asking duplicates
Use anonymous mode to get honest questions from shy students
Address common questions verbally and mark as answered
Save complex questions for end-of-session Q&A time
Export Q&A after session for study material
bestPractices: Allocate specific Q&A time during session
Acknowledge all questions even if you can't answer immediately
Use Q&A insights to improve future sessions
Make Q&A part of grading to increase participation

anonymousMode.description: Students can ask questions without revealing their identity
anonymousMode.whenToUse: Sensitive topics, shy students, encourage honest questions
anonymousMode.howToEnable: Toggle 'Allow Anonymous Questions' in session settings
anonymousMode.limitations: Cannot identify who asked, harder to follow up individually

student.overview: Ask questions during sessions and upvote questions from classmates. Get answers from your teacher in real-time.

askQuestion: Choose to post as yourself or anonymously (if enabled)
Your question appears in Q&A feed
upvote: Browse through questions in Q&A feed
If someone already asked your question, upvote it instead of posting duplicate
Click upvote icon next to the question
viewAnswers: Answered questions show teacher's response below
Get notification when your question is answered
View all Q&A in session history after class

tips: Check if someone already asked your question - upvote instead
Use anonymous mode if you're hesitant
Upvote questions you also want answered
Make sure questions are relevant to current topic
canDo: Post anonymously if teacher enables it
Edit your question before teacher answers
View all Q&A from the session
See when teacher answers your question
cannotDo: Edit question after teacher answers it
Delete your question after teacher answered
Ask questions in sessions you haven't joined

good: "Could you explain the difference between X and Y?"
"I didn't understand the step where we..."
"What's the real-world application of this concept?"
avoid: "Will this be on the test?" (ask teacher directly)

commonIssues.solution: Check character limit, ensure you're still in session, verify internet connection, try refreshing
Refresh page, check if it was flagged, ensure session is active
Verify you're logged in, refresh page, check if you already upvoted

commonIssues.problem: Want to delete question but can't
commonIssues.solution: You can only delete unanswered questions. Contact teacher if needed

anonymousTips: Use anonymous mode for sensitive or potentially embarrassing questions
Still be respectful and appropriate even when anonymous
Teacher cannot see who asked anonymous questions
